comment: The served bundle: one ExecutionPolicy plus the capability versions it pins (owner decision D25, docs/design/capability-policy.md). Only the owner moves `active`, and only after a release-gate PASS (training/gate.py promote --approved-by). `previous` stays loaded so a rollback is a pointer flip; it is null because this is the first policy-shaped deployment, so there is nothing to roll back to yet. `status` is the bundle's lifecycle state, not a gate verdict: D23 (DeBERTa decides, Stage 1 observe-only) was and remains pending the gate (D17), and converting it to a policy changed no decision (T3: identical on all 2,000 replay items, reports/policy-runtime/t3_d23_equivalence.json), so the pending status carries over unchanged. The previous sentinel-registry-v1 state of this file is in git history and still loads (it is converted in memory).
